package.name: moz1_sim_bridge
package.description: Host-side (ROS2 Humble) glue nodes that adapt the raw topics Isaac Sim emits to the exact contract the real-robot Nav2/SLAM/MoveIt stack expects: * joint_name_remap : rename sim joint names <-> canonical URDF names on /joint_states and /joint_command (pass-through if already canonical). * pc2_to_livox : optional sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 -> livox_ros_driver2/CustomMsg converter for the FAST-LIO2 path.
